name: vacation-rental-search
description: Search vacation rentals using the HomeToGo-powered MCP service.

interface.longDescription:
HomeToGo: Find Your Perfect Vacation Rental

Search millions of vacation rentals by destination, dates, group size, budget, and amenities, and browse results right in the chat. When you find a place you love, click through to see full details and book.

Try asking:
Beach house in Florida for 6 people, July 10-17
Pet-friendly cabin in the Smoky Mountains under $200/night
Villa with a pool in Tuscany for a family of 4 in August
3-bedroom apartment in Barcelona next weekend

Good to know
Search only: bookings and payments happen on the provider's site.
Your privacy: we don't store your searches or collect your name, email, or chats.
Optional analytics: anonymous usage data is only collected if you allow it. Everything works the same either way. Shared only with HomeToGo GmbH.
defaultPrompt: Find vacation rentals in Lisbon for two guests.
Search for a family-friendly rental in Italy with a pool.
Find a three-bedroom vacation rental within my budget.

review.commerce_description: Search and referral only; the integration does not accept payments or complete bookings.

positive.description: Start a fresh conversation with this plugin selected; complete legitimate connection authentication only if required. Basic destination, dates, and adult count.
positive.prompt: Find vacation rentals in Lisbon for two adults, checking in March 12, 2027 and checking out March 15, 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_vacation_rentals with the following user-supplied constraints: {"location": "Lisbon", "arrival": "2027-03-12", "duration": 3, "adults": 2}. Use the explicitly named place as location, without a geolocation lookup. Preserve the explicitly selected destination and resolve the stated dates to a three-night stay. Present only offers and referral links supported by the actual tool response. Do not invent prices, availability, amenities, or property details, and do not book or pay. If the service returns no offers or reports an error, explain that exact condition; do not fabricate a successful search. A service failure is not evidence of a successful live demo.

Update package version to 1.1.9; the private browser package remains unchanged. Add the publisher-supplied demo recording URL to review metadata. Update the public listing description with the publisher-supplied text. Remove the decorative house emoji, normalize the date-range dash, and use plain-text examples and disclosure paragraphs.
